svg.aria-label: Stage 2: Two-node CAN bus system (two breadboards)
svg.text: Stage 2: Two-node CAN bus system (two breadboards)
CAN BUS: 2 twisted wires, 30 to 50 cm
120 ohm at each end (usually built into the module)
one GND wire joins the two nodes
CAN uses the ESP32 built-in controller (TWAI) on GPIO17 / GPIO16, so there is no MCP2515 module and no 5V logic risk to the ESP32.
Each ESP32 is powered by its own USB cable. The SD module goes on the 5V rail if it has a regulator chip, otherwise on 3.3V.
